verdict.rationale: Vestd documents granting options through its EMI, unapproved and CSOP schemes, and claims board-ready governance with deed/witness signatures. It also sells 409A valuations as a separate paid service for UK companies issuing options to US taxpayers. However, there is no evidence these pieces form a single integrated end-to-end grant workflow, or that strike prices are tied automatically to a 409A valuation. Missing for 10: an explicit board approval step within the option grant flow, a 409A valuation built into the grant to set the strike price, a single end-to-end workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
